dataset.title: Motion and heart rate from a wrist-worn wearable and labeled sleep from polysomnography
dataset.citation: Walch O. (2019) PhysioNet, doi:10.13026/hmhs-py35; Walch O. et al., Sleep 42(12) 2019
dataset.licence: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
dataset.accel: raw tri-axial, g, ~50 Hz, irregular timestamps
dataset.hr: Apple Watch PPG heart rate, bpm, every ~5 s
dataset.labels: PSG, AASM, 30 s epochs, single RPSGT scorer; 0 wake, 1-4 NREM, 5 REM, -1 unscored

protocol: leave-one-subject-out; gap epochs (< 50 % samples) scored as wake; night metrics use parkinsense.sleep.night definitions applied to both PSG labels and predictions
